# Access management

Owner: @compliant-org/security
Last reviewed: 2025-11-01

## Onboarding
Access is requested in the IT portal and granted through SSO groups.

## Offboarding
Within 24 hours of departure: disable the SSO account, remove the person from GitHub and AWS, and revoke CI tokens.

## Access reviews
Privileged access is reviewed quarterly.

## Key rotation
Database credentials and API keys are rotated every 90 days and immediately on exposure or personnel change.
